data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin for managing and interacting with printers on Windows platforms.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to discover available printers, query printer properties, and send various types of print jobs on Windows. Supports raw ESC/POS commands for thermal receipt printers, rich text documents, and PDF files.
use_when: You need to print receipts or tickets to thermal printers on Windows
You need to send PDF documents or formatted text to office printers from a Windows Flutter app
avoid_when: You are targeting non-Windows platforms like Android, iOS, or macOS
You require complex UI print preview screens out of the box
strengths: Built-in ESC/POS receipt builder for thermal printers
Supports multiple print modes including raw data, rich text, and PDFs
Hardware control features like cash drawer opening, paper cutting, and beeping
weaknesses: Limited exclusively to the Windows platform
Emojis and unicode characters are not supported natively by thermal printers
data.setup_notes: Requires Windows 10 or higher and Flutter 3.0.0 or higher.
